description: Fabric 26.2 companion mod for Flashback: adds the client's own sent packets and per-tick input to Flashback recordings (MIT)

mods.name: FlashbackServerbound
mods.description: Adds the client's own side to Flashback recordings: every packet it sends and its input each tick. The replays still play in Flashback without this mod.

releases.notes:
Companion mod for Flashback 0.43.x on Minecraft 26.2 (Fabric Loader 0.19.3+, Java 25, Fabric API): adds every packet the client sends and the client's input each tick to Flashback recordings. It contains no Flashback code; install it in the same `mods` folder as an unmodified Flashback from Modrinth. Replays still play in Flashback with or without it, and recordings made without it are still fine but lack the player's own inputs. Replays are saved in `.minecraft/flashback/replays/`.

Licence: MIT.
